title: Filter Conveyor
body:
"Allows passthrough of a specific object or type. Assign the object by touching it onto the pad. Some properties may be assigned."


The Filter Conveyor is a structure that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics for $280. It is a standard Straight Conveyor with additional filtering controls.

Details

While the Filter Conveyor is otherwise identical to the Straight Conveyor, the Filter Conveyor has an additional filtering option. When a material is pressed up against the sensor, the Filter Conveyor can then begin filtering objects that pass through it.

The Filter Conveyor has two modes: allowing everything but the filtered item, and only allowing the filtered item. All items that are "caught" by the filter will be ejected out of the bottom of the belt. A player may wish to use a Material Laser hooked up to a logic system that controls an Intersection Conveyor if this functionality is undesirable.
